events.title: 구이저우성 전닝현에서 태어나다
events.description: 중국 구이저우성 전닝현의 작은 마을에서 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born in a small village in Zhenning County, Guizhou Province, China.

events.title: 충칭건축공정학원에 들어가다
events.title_en: He enrolled at Chongqing Institute of Civil Engineering and Architecture
events.description_en: He enrolled at the Chongqing Institute of Civil Engineering and Architecture, majoring in heating and ventilation engineering.

events.title: 인민해방군 공병대에 들어가다
events.title_en: He joined the PLA Engineering Corps
events.description: 인민해방군 공병대에 들어가 동북 지역 화학섬유 공장 건설을 맡았다. 병사에서 기술자를 거쳐 연대 부지휘관급까지 올랐다.
events.description_en: He joined the Engineering Corps of the People's Liberation Army and took charge of building a chemical fiber factory in northeastern China. He rose from soldier to technician to a rank equivalent to deputy regimental commander.

events.title: 제대해 선전 국영기업에서 일하다
events.title_en: He left the army and worked at a state firm in Shenzhen
events.description: 공병대가 해체되며 군에서 물러났다. 선전으로 옮겨 남해석유 선전개발서비스라는 국영기업 물류 부서에서 일했다.
events.description_en: When the Engineering Corps was disbanded, he left the army. He moved to Shenzhen and worked in the logistics division of a state firm, the South Sea Oil Shenzhen Development Service Company.

events.title: 화웨이를 세우다
events.description: 통신연구소 출신 동료 몇 명과 함께 자본금 2만 1천 위안으로 화웨이를 세웠다. 마흔두 살이었다.
events.description_en: With a handful of former telecom researchers, he founded Huawei with 21,000 yuan in capital. He was forty-two.

events.title: 딸 멍완저우가 캐나다에서 체포되다
events.title_en: His daughter Meng Wanzhou was arrested in Canada
events.description: 화웨이 최고재무책임자인 딸 멍완저우가 미국의 요청으로 밴쿠버에서 체포됐다. 이란 제재 위반 혐의였다.
events.description_en: His daughter Meng Wanzhou, Huawei's chief financial officer, was arrested in Vancouver at the request of the United States, on charges related to violating Iran sanctions.

events.title: 화웨이가 미국 거래제한 명단에 오르다
events.title_en: Huawei was placed on the US Entity List
events.description: 미국 상무부가 화웨이를 거래제한 명단에 올려 미국 기술에 대한 접근을 크게 막았다.
events.description_en: The US Department of Commerce placed Huawei on its Entity List, severely restricting the company's access to American technology.

events.title: 딸이 풀려나 중국으로 돌아가다
events.title_en: His daughter was released and returned to China
events.description: 멍완저우가 미국 법무부와 기소유예 합의를 맺고 캐나다에서 풀려나 중국으로 돌아갔다.
events.description_en: Meng Wanzhou reached a deferred prosecution agreement with the US Justice Department, was released in Canada, and returned to China.
